text:
Maya (observability): quick check-in on the postmortem follow-ups for the recent incidents — missing spans, aggregation anomalies, and recurring ETL lag. Need clear owners + ETA per remediation. I uploaded a rough tracker: https://rwd.internal/pm/obs-fixlist. Can owners ack and add due dates?

Samir: I can take the aggregator RCA and plan. Will do initial RCA in 72h, then aim for a 2-week fix + tests + canary rollout. Starting with join logic and dedupe checks.

Leo: I'll own the missing spans instrumentation. Initial look: three services drop span headers when retrying; short-term patch + extra logging possible. Estimate ~3 days including a small canary.

Tanya: I'll own the ETL lag recurring pattern. Looks like the 02:15 UTC batch run hits peak concurrency and stalls on a downstream queue. I will validate job concurrency, queue depth, and retry backoff. ETA 5 business days for mitigation + monitoring.

Arjun: For aggregation, my hypothesis is late-arriving events cause duplicate counting in the rollup window. Proposed short-term mitigation: dedupe by event_id within the ingestion window, plus a compaction job. I'll prototype a fix in branch `fix/agg-dedupe` today.

Priya: For spans, I'll add a drop-rate metric and a feature-flagged logging gate so we can measure without full rollout. Plan: add metric + dashboard + alert, then enable FF canary. Can start tomorrow AM.

incident-bot: automated note — added action items to tracker: #OBS-1723 (aggregation RCA/fix), #OBS-1724 (span instrumentation + dashboards), #OBS-1725 (ETL concurrency tuning). Link: https://rwd.internal/tracker/OBS-1723

Samir: quick mitigation idea — run a backfill to correct recent mis-aggregations while we work on the code fix. Example backfill command I'm testing:

```
# run in analytics cluster
python tools/backfill.py \
  --job aggregation_recompute \
  --from 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z \
  --to 2026-03-07T23:59:59Z \
  --parallel 8
```

Will monitor cost and runtime; prefer to run during low-traffic window.

Maya (observability): @Arjun @Leo please add owner + firm due date in the tracker by EOD. Also, add the rollout rollback plan (flags, canary percentages, fallback model) for aggregation change.

Arjun: acked — added draft in tracker and opened PR: https://rwd.internal/pull/agg-dedupe-112. Note: tests failing on an edge where event_id is null; adding guard. Will update by EOD.

Leo: acked — I filed a small patch to preserve span headers on retry: https://rwd.internal/pull/span-header-fix-37. Will instrument more logs behind FF; canary tomorrow.

Priya: added dash for span-drop-rate and a Grafana panel. Alert threshold: drop_rate > 0.5% for 15m triggers page. Posted screenshot in tracker.

Tanya: scheduled a deeper ETL runbook: adjust concurrency from 16->24 for the 02:15 job, monitor queue depth, and add exponential backoff to the aggregator consumer. I'll run a controlled increase in staging tomorrow.

Samir: RCA complete — root cause: double-join on an outer table when new event mappings existed; duplicate rows made it into rollups when consumer retries replayed events. PR updated: https://rwd.internal/pull/agg-dedupe-112 (now includes dedupe + null-event_id guard). Running unit + integration tests.

Maya (observability): great. Two asks before merge: 1) add a regression test with late-arriving event and duplicate sequence, 2) define rollback steps in PR description (feature flag toggle + fast path to previous pipeline).

Arjun: added regression test and rollback steps. Tests pass locally; running CI. If green, plan is staged canary tomorrow morning 09:30 PT at 10% traffic, ramp 10/30/100 over 6 hours.

Priya: will enable span logging FF on the same canary cohort so we can correlate span-drop-rate with aggregation metrics.

Maya (observability): Let's do weekly check-ins until all three tickets are closed — Mondays 09:30 PT. First check-in next Monday. Add status updates to the tracker daily.

incident-bot: reminder scheduled: weekly check-in created in calendar "OBS remediation check" starting next Mon 09:30 PT.

Samir: status update later same day — PR merged to staging, integration tests passed, canary deploy scheduled for tomorrow 09:30 PT. Backfill dry-run completed on small slice, looks ok.

Leo: span FF canary enabled for 5% now; seeing extra logs as expected; no increase in latency.

Tanya: ran concurrency test in staging; queue depth reduced with 24 workers, no downstream overload in staging. Will run a controlled prod increase during the canary window.

Maya (observability): thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the single source for daily check-ins until closure. If any blocker emerges, ping here and tag me.

Samir: thanks — will post conclusion + postmortem follow-up note when backfill completes and canary is healthy. :thumbsup:

Priya: noted — I'll attach dashboard screenshots post-canary.

Arjun: canary 10% started. Monitoring logs, regression tests, and metrics panels.

incident-bot: action items status snapshot: #OBS-1723: in canary, #OBS-1724: in canary, #OBS-1725: staging validation.

Maya (observability): closing daily check-in for today. Next scheduled check-in: next Mon 09:30 PT. If everything remains green after canary and backfill, we'll schedule a final remediation review and close tickets.

Samir: noted. Will update tracker when backfill completes (ETA 48h).

Leo: will confirm span fix promoted after canary + 24h observation.

Tanya: will report ETL job metrics post-concurrency change.

Priya: will attach final dashboards and alert thresholds to the tracker before closure.
